item.title: Music's biggest stars use the Grammys stage to protest Trump's immigration crackdown
item.description: Entertainment’s awards season has coincided with the Trump administration’s mass deportation campaign in Minneapolis, forcing artists to decide whether and how to join the growing cultural revolt against immigration crackdowns.

item.title: Syrian rapper Al Darwish returns home after 13 years to perform in post-Assad Damascus
item.description: DAMASCUS, Syria (AP) — Hani Al Sawah recently walked the streets of Damascus, Syria's capital, with wide-eyed excitement. It had been 13 years since the rap artist last was in Syria .

item.title: Preliminary, partial results put Costa Rican president's handpicked successor on verge of presidency
item.description: CARTAGO, Costa Rica (AP) — Preliminary and partial results showed the Costa Rican president’s handpicked successor poised to win the presidency in a crowded field after Sunday's election.

item.title: NHL roundup: Lightning rally from 4-goal deficit to beat Bruins 6-5 in Stadium Series thriller
Snack like a pro on Super Bowl Sunday with Panko-crusted chicken strips and game-changing sauce
item.description: Sometimes a chicken nugget is just a chicken nugget. Sometimes it’s a crisp, panko-crusted strip of chicken breast with a sweet and tangy sauce. This is the latter. Super Bowl Sunday is snack time at its finest.

item.title: Bad Bunny wins album of the year at the 2026 Grammy Awards, a first for a Spanish-language album
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Bad Bunny won album of the year at the 2026 Grammy Awards for his critically-acclaimed “Debí Tirar Más Fotos,” closing out a surprising and history-making night.

item.title: Son of Norway's crown princess to go on trial on rape and other charges
item.description: OSLO, Norway (AP) — The eldest son of Norway's crown princess will go on trial Tuesday on multiple charges including rape in a high-profile case that has been an embarrassment to the royal family.

item.title: Addison Rae, Olivia Dean and other rising stars take up space on Grammys red carpet
item.description: Rising music stars ushered in a fresh new era of red carpet dressing at the Grammys on Sunday as they embodied their music personas and let their style take center stage.
